correctness.rationale: Cayley–Hamilton gives V²=0. In the noncommutative expansion the even-V terms reduce exactly to 2(UV+VU)². Direct 2×2 coordinates give UV+VU=tr(U)V+tr(UV)I. Writing τ=tr(U), α=tr(UV), its square is α²I+2ατV; the trace is 2α², so characteristic zero forces α=0, and α=0 is sufficient. Fresh symbolic reconstruction verified the matrix identity and the quartic residual modulo det(V)=0, and the displayed example has det(V)=0, tr(UV)=0, zero quartic residual, and x≠w.

final_claim: For every characteristic-zero 2×2 matrix U and every traceless singular 2×2 matrix V, with X=U+V, Y=U−V and Z=U, the quartic equation X^4+Y^4=2Z^4 holds exactly when tr(UV)=0; the displayed integer pair gives a counterexample to the narrower necessity asserted for the source construction.
limitations: Only the source's 2×2 U±V substitution with traceless singular V is classified.
